release_notes:
SSPO Invoicing Prep fills in the invoice and prints it. Once a nest has its
invoice number in the Working Forecast List (the PS/Inv column), the Invoice
Supplement comes out with the invoice number and ship date filled in, and a
PDF of it lands in that nest's Invoicing Docs folder as ASA Invoice No. XXXXX
Supplement.pdf, right next to where the Mie Trak invoice goes.

- A nest with no PS/Inv yet gets a blank Invoice # and no PDF, and the popup
  at the end tells you which ones. Fill the forecast in and run again.

- The nest's pricing calcs come along too. Shapes: the Linear Inch Calcs
  folder is zipped into Invoicing Docs. Plate: the LINEAR INCH CALC workbook
  is copied in. A nest with neither is named in the popup.

Part sketches come out complete.

- A PART SKETCH page that lost its drawing gets it back. When the report
  server prints "The resource of this report item is not reachable" where
  the picture should be, 911 Setup and Remove Ticket now find that part's
  sketch pictures in the batch's WPDD SKETCHES folder and put them on the
  page. They only ever look in the batch you are working on.

- The material is on every sketch. The same HSS, OSS, CRES316 that goes in
  the cover's Material Type cell is now written in each PART SKETCH's MATL:
  box, so the shop can scribe from the print.

922 Setup: source material labels and Apply pallet labels to existing cards
now start checked. Clear them on a run that should skip them.

922 Setup: the BATCH PROGRESS card now goes in the batch's HOLD bucket, on
its own, instead of sitting among the order cards.
